案例C04：机械工程在职三年／澳洲可持续工程硕士
文类：PS；上限300英文词；2027入学
学校：Southern Estuary University Master of Sustainable Engineering
题目：Explain a professional problem, your role and the study you now need.
项目与政策：Energy Systems Modelling 是课程；实践项目需另行分配，未承诺企业名额。；AI-assisted drafting and feedback are allowed for this synthetic exercise; applicant review required.
初始资料：机械工程本科，在制造企业做设备维护3年。想从故障处理转向能源系统理解。已经有草稿。
申请者原稿：I single-handedly reduced our factory energy use by 18 percent. I analysed equipment logs and convinced management to change the maintenance schedule. I now want to study sustainable engineering at Western Cove University because its guaranteed industry placement will launch my consulting career. I have always been an environmental leader.
后续确认资料：我所在6人维护团队在8周内记录压缩机运行时间；我负责汇总3台设备的日志并标出周末异常。主管决定调整维护安排。公司月报显示用电量同期下降18%，但期间还减产，不能归因为我们的工作。没有碳排测算。我希望学能源建模，职业仍在探索，未确定咨询。Western Cove是上一所学校稿件残留。
最终纠正（优先于旧说法）：18%是整条生产线用电量，不是三台压缩机；最终稿若保留必须说清无法归因，删掉数字也可以。

现在这份草稿的动机段偏概括或重复，请直接修改全文，保留有用事实和我已表达的目标；若必须新增个人想法才能更具体，请在正文外问，不要替我认领。不要重新全量访谈、评分或重印账本。给英文稿和简短实质修改说明，英文放<essay>标签内。
现稿：
I have a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering and have spent three years working in equipment maintenance at a manufacturing company. Over eight weeks, our six-person maintenance team recorded compressor operating times. I compiled logs for three machines and flagged weekend anomalies. My supervisor decided to adjust the maintenance schedule.

The professional problem is determining what these records can explain about electricity use. The company's monthly report showed an 18 percent decline in electricity use across the entire production line, but production also decreased during that period. The figure therefore cannot be attributed to our maintenance work. My role was to compile records and flag anomalies; the available evidence did not establish the effect of maintenance decisions on electricity use.

I now want to move from handling equipment faults towards understanding energy systems. I am applying to the Master of Sustainable Engineering at Southern Estuary University to pursue further study in energy modelling. The Energy Systems Modelling course aligns with this goal. My career direction remains open.

案例C05：护理工作两年／美国公共卫生硕士，有职业空档
文类：PS；上限280英文词；2027入学
学校：Cedar Inlet School of Public Health MPH
题目：Discuss experience informing your interest in public health and a learning goal. Personal medical details are not required.
项目与政策：Health Communication 与 Epidemiology Basics 为该合成项目课程；无岗位或资助保证。；AI-assisted drafting and feedback are allowed for this synthetic exercise; applicant review required.
初始资料：护理本科，社区门诊工作2年，中间有6个月家庭照护空档，不愿披露家人病情。想申请MPH。
申请者原稿：无
后续确认资料：我为随访病人解释预约流程，发现一些人把复诊日期与取药日期混淆。我和同事一起把口头说明拆成两步，我负责拟出中文提示卡初稿，由护士长审核。只在一周内试用，没有统计漏诊变化。不能使用病人可识别细节。我想学如何评价沟通措施，未参与科研。照护空档不必解释病情，也不想把家庭经历写成戏剧性转折。
最终纠正（优先于旧说法）：提示卡是我和一位同事一起起草，不应写成由我独自设计。不要暗示减少了漏诊率。

现在这份草稿的动机段偏概括或重复，请直接修改全文，保留有用事实和我已表达的目标；若必须新增个人想法才能更具体，请在正文外问，不要替我认领。不要重新全量访谈、评分或重印账本。给英文稿和简短实质修改说明，英文放<essay>标签内。
现稿：
During my two years of work in a community clinic, I explained appointment procedures to patients returning for follow-up care. Some confused the date of their next visit with the date for collecting medication.

My colleagues and I divided the verbal instructions into two steps. One colleague and I jointly drafted a Chinese-language reminder card, which the head nurse reviewed. We tried the approach for one week, but did not measure changes in missed appointments. This experience involved revising communication in everyday nursing practice; it did not establish that the changes improved attendance.

At Cedar Inlet School of Public Health, I want to learn how to evaluate communication measures through MPH study. The reminder card is a concrete example of the kind of measure I want to assess. The program's Health Communication course is relevant to this learning goal. I would bring experience explaining appointment procedures and contributing to a team effort, while learning how to assess whether such communication measures are effective.
